adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `updateEvent` now destructures `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event?.destinationCalendar && event?.destinationCalendar.length > 0 ? event.destinationCalendar : [];` and uses `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId` to set the organizer attendee `email`. Since `destinationCalendar` is now an array (multi-host/collective), this hard-codes the organizer identity to the first destination calendar regardless of which calendar is actually being updated. The same method later selects the calendar to update based on `externalCalendarId`, so for updates targeting a non-first host’s calendar, the organizer attendee email can be wrong.
